Auto Agent Builder is now live on Swarms 👾🤖

Turn a single task into a complete AI agent team. Describe what you want to accomplish, and Auto Agent Builder generates a ready-to-run roster of agents with specialized roles, system prompts, models, and parameters.

Highlights

• Generate an entire agent team from one task
• Automatically divide responsibilities across specialized agents
• Review and edit every agent before running it
• Choose an exact team size or let the builder determine the smallest team needed
• Export agents as JSON, CSV, cURL, Python, TypeScript, or Go
• Take generated agents directly into your Swarms workflows
• Available through both the Swarms Cloud interface and API

post.text:
Claude Coders: I just shipped 'grapevine 🍇'

Your Claude Code sessions can now talk to each other, but by default they're blind to what each other are doing.

'grapevine 🍇' is a Claude Code plugin that fixes that.

grapevine 🍇 is open-source, free and experimental. Try it out at the link below 👇.

draft.title: grapevine 🍇 — Claude Code sessions talk to each other
draft.description: Open-source Claude Code plugin that lets sessions share context via a local graph. When two sessions touch the same file, grapevine drops an advisory note so Claude can decide whether to message the other session. Free & experimental.

items.notes: Indie open-source plugin. Note: Anthropic/ClaudeDevs also shipped native session messaging around the same time; this is a community alternative.
